title: unified-rollouts-quarantine-probing-autorollback-safety-guards
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: We observed several recent rollouts where transient metric spikes during the probing stage triggered automated rollbacks even though downstream metrics recovered once probing reached quorum. This PR introduces explicit quarantine and quorum-based safety guards in the unified rollouts autorollback workflow so that transient signals have reduced chance of causing noisy rollbacks. Motivation: make autorollback decisions more robust for canary/AB/shadow rollouts by requiring metric quorum across probes and adding a quarantine window and backoff before initiating automatic rollback. Changes summary: 1) add a Quarantine stage that sits between Probing and Active rollback: when a metric breach is detected during probing we now enter Quarantine which delays final rollback for a configurable window, collects additional probes, and requires a quorum policy to mark the breach as persistent. 2) Quorum policy: support n-of-m probe quorum and weighted-metric quorum (e.g., require 3/5 probes or 2 critical metrics + 1 secondary), configurable per rollout spec. 3) Backoff & jitter: incremental backoff and randomized jitter before evaluating quorum to avoid synchronized rollbacks across regions. 4) Telemetry & observability: new rollout/trial events (quarantine_enter, quarantine_evaluate, quorum_met, quorum_failed) and dashboard panels added for quarantine state counts and probe distributions. 5) E2E & unit tests: add deterministic e2e scenarios for transient spikes and recovery, plus unit coverage for quorum evaluation. 6) Migration: rollout controller supports existing rollout specs; default behavior is unchanged unless quarantine/quorum fields are set. Related: ENG-3421 (design doc), ENG-3499 (incidence follow-up). Checklist: - [x] Design doc + Linear link - [x] Implementation of quarantine state machine and quorum evaluator - [x] Unit tests for quorum evaluator - [x] E2E tests simulating transient spikes and sustained regressions - [x] Observability events and dashboard queries - [x] Documentation update in rollout API reference Implementation notes: - New config fields added to rollout spec: quarantine.window_ms, quorum.n, quorum.m, quorum.weights, quarantine.backoff_strategy. - Quarantine lives entirely inside the rollout controller; we do not change serving runtime routing during quarantine (traffic percentages unchanged). - Autorollback will only proceed to rollback if quorum evaluation remains true after the quarantine window and backoff attempts. - Added safety override: projects may opt-out by setting quarantine.enabled=false (not recommended). Testing & stability: ran full unit test suite and integrated e2e harness (simulated LB and synthetic probes) locally and in CI. Perf canary included to ensure controller latency impact is <1ms p50 and no observable effect on serving paths. Rollout plan: merge to main, behind feature flag rollout.quarantine.enabled=true. Gradual enablement across clusters: start with internal staging (0%), then select customers (opt-in), then global enforced default after 4 weeks of telemetry. Rollback & mitigation plan: if we observe regressions caused by quorum logic, we can temporarily disable via feature flag and revert controller config. Notes for reviewers: pay attention to quorum edge cases (overlapping probes, missing metrics) and fallback behavior for missing telemetry.

review_comments: Diego Rivera: Left small comments on quorum evaluator — prefer early-return on missing metrics to improve readability. Author replied with refactor and added comment explaining fallback behavior.
Sara Liu: Requested additional e2e which simulates delayed metric ingestion; author added test and updated quarantine window handling to tolerate bounded delays.
Tomás González: Asked for telemetry event names to be backwards-compatible; author updated events and added a migration note in observability docs.
release_notes: Adds quarantine stage and quorum-based safety guards to unified rollouts autorollback workflow to reduce noisy rollbacks from transient probe spikes. Includes telemetry events, e2e tests, and rollout spec fields for configurable quorum and backoff.

merge_summary: Squash-merged to main after reviews and CI green. Feature guarded behind rollout.quarantine.enabled flag; documented migration and rollout steps.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag rollout.quarantine.enabled controls behaviour. Default unset = no change. Operators should monitor new telemetry events quarantine_enter/quarantine_evaluate/quorum_met/quorum_failed and dashboards for quarantine backlogs.
